name: sc5314_diploid
key_challenge: Real heterozygosity, loss-of-heterozygosity (LOH) tracts, paralog families across haplotypes

reference.notes: Phased diploid assembly — 8 chromosome pairs. Use this target for heterozygosity and LOH testing. Hosted at CGD, not NCBI.

simulation.command: dwgsim -1 150 -2 150 -C 50 -z {rng_seed} ../reference/reference.fasta reads && mv reads.bwa.read1.fastq.gz reads_1.fastq.gz && mv reads.bwa.read2.fastq.gz reads_2.fastq.gz
simulation.notes: Simulate from both haplotypes (full diploid FASTA). Reads from heterozygous sites are the diagnostic signal.

truth.simulated: dwgsim read name encodes true origin coordinates; evaluate with paftools.js mapeval

benchmark_notes: A PacBio HiFi read set exists (SRR23724250) for long-read assembly comparison — not needed for short-read mapping benchmark. Compare with sc5314_haploid to isolate heterozygosity contribution.
